surveyMeta.description: An async choose-your-own-adventure for ignatious to bridge the gap after Hangar 12 and learn about Team 1: Shatter Stamper before the race.
surveyMeta.title: ignatious's Hangar Detour
surveyMeta.name: ignatious's Hangar Detour

blocks.content: As you watch Iggy curl into a bowling ball of doom, careening down the corridor and dragging a swarm of shouting Turbaned Guards with him, you find yourself left standing in a half-empty corridor. Before you can sneak away, three Indigo Turban guards turn the corner and spot you near the Restricted Hangar Bay 12.
They lower their stun-pikes. 'You there! Halt! Candidates are barred from this sector after shift end. State your business!'

ports.subtext: Trust your reflexes and dash into the shadows of the scaffolding.

ports.text: Talk your way out of it
ports.subtext: Use your diplomatic presence to convince them you are lost.

blocks.content: The corridor is slick with aether-oil runoff. You leap over a crate of brass valves, attempting to slide under their reach. Add your Agility modifier to the roll!
You slide cleanly beneath the first guard's stun-pike, kicking off a steam pipe to pivot around the second. Before they can coordinate, you vanish into the maze of tarps and scaffolding.

ports.subtext: Look for a safe place to hide.

blocks.content: You slip on a patch of oil. One of the guards clips your shoulder with a stun-pike, sending a jolt of disruptive energy through your body before you can scramble back up and tear yourself away into the scaffolding. You take 2 Stress.

ports.subtext: Nursing your sore shoulder.

blocks.content: You stand tall, projecting the confidence of a candidate who belongs here. Add your Presence modifier to the roll!

You weave a smooth story about being sent by a logistics instructor to double-check a valve specification. The guards look at each other, hesitate, and lower their pikes. 'Fine. Move along, candidate, before the Warden spots you.'

ports.subtext: Slip into the next hangar aisle.

blocks.content: 'Nice try, candidate,' the lead guard sneers, grabbing your collar. You have to pull away violently, ripping your sleeve and taking a painful shock from a stun-pike as you bolt into the shadows. You take 2 Stress.

ports.subtext: Nursing your sore arm.

blocks.content: You catch your breath behind a massive canvas partition. Suddenly, a hand clamps over your mouth and drags you backward into a darkened alcove. Your skin flares with heat—but the hand is immune. It's Ember.

Your childhood cousin looks relieved. 'ignatious! Thank the Ancestors. You're quiet on your feet. Everyone is chasing that rolling metal ball of a student towards Hangar 12, but I need you right now. It's about Valerius's team.'

ports.subtext: She's your cousin and she looks genuinely desperate. Let's see what she wants.
You can't just leave Iggy to the guards. You need to see where he went.

blocks.content: You slide behind a massive canvas partition, nursing your sore, static-shocked shoulder. Suddenly, a hand clamps over your mouth and drags you backward into a darkened alcove. Your skin flares with heat—but the hand is immune. It's Ember.

She spots you wincing. 'ignatious! Get in here, quick! I saw those guards clip you with a pike. Keep your head down—we have to hide before they double back. And I need your help right now—it's about Valerius's team.'

ports.subtext: Slip away with Ember before the patrol turns back around.
Even with your shoulder aching, you want to double-back to check on Iggy.

blocks.content: You peer through the scaffolding, attempting to track the path of destruction and guard shouts. Finding Iggy in this chaos requires a perfect roll (DC 20). Add your Agility modifier!

outcomes.label: Failure! Lost him in the dust!

blocks.content: You slip through a high catwalk and look down. Through the dust, you see Iggy surrounded by several guards. Standing before him is Warden Rovaldi himself. Oddly, Iggy doesn't seem in danger; he's gesturing excitedly at Rovaldi's mechanical eye, and the Warden seems more amused than angry. However, the way down is completely blocked by guards.
Ember tugs your sleeve. 'See? He's fine! But we are NOT if we stay here. Follow me!'

ports.subtext: Iggy is safe. Time to focus on Ember.

blocks.content: The shouts fade into distant corridors. You completely lose track of where Iggy ended up. Ember gets more persistent, blocking your path. 'He's gone, ignatious! And the guards are doubling back. If we don't move now, we both get locked in cells!'

ports.subtext: Concede and follow her into the opposite hangar.
Refuse to give up on Iggy.

blocks.content: Ember mutters a curse, grabs your wrist with a grip like heated steel, and drags you forcefully down a side service duct. 'I am not asking, cousin! Valerius's rig is at stake, which means our future standing in this city is at stake!'

ports.subtext: Yield to her stubbornness.

blocks.content: Ember leads you into the hangar bay opposite Hangar 12. Tarped off from public view is the massive, brutalist heavy crawler of Team 1: **Shatter Stamper**. The rig, **The Ironclad**, looms like a steel fortress on treads. The pit crew is running around in a panic.

Ember speaks fast: 'The team is short in Ash-Blood energy. We need to infuse anything you have into the craft. The judges ruled they couldn't replace their backup resonator—which Warden Rovaldi confiscated in Bay 4. It's exactly what that logistics kid, Finch, was gossiping about! Without a source of Ash-Blood heat, the rig will stall in the tight quarters of the first run.'

ports.subtext: Help your cousin and the crew without asking for anything in return.
Agree to help in exchange for private interviews/access to Valerius Sterling.

ports.text: Negotiate: Access to the Pit Crew
ports.subtext: Ask for access to the pit crew's technical notes before the race (though you cannot pilot).
Demand a favor from Ember and Valerius that you can cash in later.

blocks.content: You try to barter your unique fire for access to the radio host himself. Add your Presence modifier to the roll!

Ember hesitates, then nods. 'Fine. Help us stabilize this rig, and I'll get you a private audience on the Sterling airship VIP deck before the race. Valerius will want to hear your story anyway.' You secured access to Valerius!

ports.subtext: Step up to the machine.

blocks.content: You ask for access to their engineering blueprints and pit crew before the race starts. Add your Presence modifier!

Alistair 'The Rook' Rookwood grunts from the rig's underside. 'Deal. You can't pilot, kid—rules are rules—but you can look at our logs and talk to the mechanics before we roll out.' You secured access to the pit crew!

ports.subtext: Step up to the machine.

blocks.content: You demand a blank favor to be cashed in at a time of your choosing. Add your Presence modifier!
Ember spits on her palm, her skin sparking. 'A favor. Traditional style. I accept, ignatious. Just don't let this rig stall!' You gained a future favor!

ports.subtext: Step up to the machine.

blocks.content: Ember shakes her head sharply. 'No time for bargaining, ignatious! We either do this now, or I find someone else. Do you want to help your clan's standing or not?'

ports.subtext: Help for the sake of learning and helping your cousin.
No deal, no help.

blocks.content: You refuse to work without a deal. Ember looks disappointed and turns back to her crew: 'Fine, get the secondary cells! We'll have to run it cold.' You slip out of the hangar empty-handed.

ports.subtext: Rest and await Session 7.

blocks.content: Ember hands you an insulated copper conduit connected to the rig's combustion manifold. 'Where can you focus your heat the best, cousin? Choose wisely.'

ports.subtext: Channel steady, radiating heat directly into the coolant conduits to pre-warm the block.
Infuse raw explosive pressure into the forward ignition jets.
Stoke the main furnace directly, feeding it with your own soot and flames.

blocks.content: Pre-warming the engine block requires precise thermal control to avoid cracking the valves. Add your Knowledge modifier!

You slowly raise the temperature of the coolant conduits. The engine purrs to life with a deep, volcanic vibration. The Rook smiles: 'Perfect resonance. That'll keep us from freezing on the launch pads.'

ports.subtext: Look around the bay.

blocks.content: You apply heat too quickly. A valve hisses and a puff of soot blows back into your face. The crew scrambles to reset the pressure. It works, but you're exhausted from holding the flare back (2 Stress).

ports.subtext: Wiping soot from your eyes.

blocks.content: Infusing the forward weapons array requires fine control over the fuel pressure. Add your Finesse modifier!
You channel your flame into the weapon's ignition nozzle. A blue-hot jet of fire flares briefly in the bay, illuminating the scaffolding. The crew cheers: 'That'll melt any barricade on the track!'

ports.subtext: Look around the bay.

blocks.content: The nozzle backfires, sending a splash of burning oil onto your forearm. Your Ash-Blood skin resists the heat, but the sudden pop shakes you (2 Stress). The flamethrower is primed, but barely.

ports.subtext: Shaking off the soot.

blocks.content: Shoveling raw lavsidian fuel and stoking the main furnace requires intense physical effort. Add your Strength modifier!

You heave the heavy fuel shovel, throwing yourself into the furnace heat. The fire roars, turning a blinding white-hot. The pressure gauges stabilize perfectly. Hammer claps your back: 'Strong arm, kid!'

ports.subtext: Look around the bay.

blocks.content: The furnace heat is oppressive, even for you. You struggle to keep pace with the fuel draw and strain your back lifting the heavy obsidian shovel (2 Stress). The furnace is hot, but you are spent.

ports.subtext: Wiping sweat from your brow.

blocks.content: As the engine stabilizes, you watch the pit crew run diagnostic checks on the Ironclad's heavy armor plating. You notice that the rig has almost no steering jets—it is designed like a moving brick.

Alistair grunts, seeing your expression: 'Shatter Stamper isn't built for a cool show, candidate. Our goal is to get into positions that keep bottlenecks and stop other crafts. It's pure attrition. We let the lighter teams show off, then we pin them.'

Ember pulls you aside: 'Matriarch Lady Ignis and the modernizer faction—the Ash Reds—are backing this rig. It's mostly for good PR. We want to look cool and capable, but we don't want to threaten the existing players yet. We want to be seen as an emerging power and the most mechanical version of Harmony Tech. Everyone thought the Ember Isles would build light and movable gliders—but we want to show up on their city and show them we can build a furnace that burns hotter than anything else.'

ports.subtext: Slip back to Block 12 before guards spot you.

blocks.content: You slip back into your room in Block 12 before the night shifts change and the patrols double. You helped prime Shatter Stamper's heavy rig for the race.

ports.subtext: Rest and await Session 7.

blocks.content: You have completed your catchup detour. Await the start of Session 7.
